kernel.note: Release 7.3.0-518.gravity: Fedora's kernel-7.3.3-200.fc44 packaging and configuration on the Linux 7.3 tarball, plus gravity-m4.patch (v7.3..ref): P3S and the Apple M4 platform support from the GravityLinux/linux integration branch (the bits/* topic branches merged in order). The J713 camera is disabled in its device tree.

mesa.note: Mesa 26.3.0-devel with Apple M4 GPU support (GL and Vulkan). The shader compiler waits for a scalar export before its inputs are reused, which fixes intermittently misplaced vertices.

mesa-fex-guest.note: x86_64 and i686 builds of the mesa entry's source, built in the fedora-44-x86_64 chroot only.

gravity-x86-mesa.note: Repacks the x86 trees of the mesa-fex-guest RPM that COPR built from the current mesa pin (gravity-x86-mesa and fex-guestos-mesa). After that build succeeds, `make pin` records its URL here and its hash in downloads.lock.json.

uboot-tools.note: Asahi/Fedora source plus nine checked-in Gravity patches through a2f6913694ff26908c16948af3f8372429782263; see UPSTREAM.md.

gravity-audio-j713.note: J713 (MacBook Air 13", M4) UCM profiles, WirePlumber DSP rules and speakersafetyd profile, added to Fedora's alsa-ucm-asahi 10, asahi-audio 4.1 and speakersafetyd 2.0.1 without changing them; see gravity-audio-j713/README.md.

gravity-bootloader.note: M4 bring-up on top of GravityLinux/bootloader main 79ff30c70f06: T8132 GPU calibration and core mask, MTP and AOP DAPF setup, system-level cache, CPU frequency init, ISP heap, NO_DISPLAY build, and m1n1.conf.example restored. Preserve DCP firmware-version and firmware-compat as 26.6.2; pair with the kernel's exact actual-version check.

gravity-scripts.note: Publish this locally pinned scripts commit to the Gravity repository.

gravity-installer.note: Qualified recovery extraction plus per-radio J773g Wi-Fi and Bluetooth factory calibration.

gravity-logos.note: CC-BY-4.0 artwork, MIT generator, separate trademark policy. Publish this locally pinned revision.

steam.note: Launcher only. Valve's ARM64 client and the ARM64 Proton build are not sources: fetch-client downloads them at each user's first start from the URLs and SHA-256 values it pins (steam/README.md, steam/PROTON-SOURCE.md).
